summary.text: Rob Bonomolo is the Republican candidate for New York State Assembly District 97 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His campaign website describes him as a lifelong Rockland County resident, union labor leader and community volunteer.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Bonomolo as having advanced from the Republican primary on June 23, 2026, and as having lost the Conservative Party primary the same day.
